item.title: Cartoon of the Week: Louisiana Snow Day essentials: survival mode activated
item.description: Louisiana snow day essentials: space heater, extension cord, boiling water, generator, candles, and a phone at 3% battery. While some outside the South might chuckle at a Louisiana winter, we know how to stay prepared, make the most of any situation, and get through it together.

item.title: LDH confirms winter storm-related deaths in Caddo Parish
item.description: The Louisiana Department of Health (LDH) has confirmed additional winter storm-related deaths in Caddo Parish as a result of extreme cold and prolonged power outages across the region. According to LDH, the Caddo Parish coroner confirmed the deaths of two adult men who died from hypothermia during the winter storm. item.title: Weather outlook: Cold, freezing fog, gradual warmup expected across Caddo, Bossier Parishes
item.description: Residents across Caddo and Bossier parishes can expect a continued stretch of cold weather, patchy freezing fog, and below-average temperatures through the weekend, followed by a slow warming trend early next week.
